about: The admin_inventory domain's truth mappings for claims about printers, shredders, mail, parcels and stored goods (kernel/speech.py truth(); VERIFY_HARDENING 13.1-13.3, 13.6; WP-D admin_inventory). Words from house_sim/data/vocab/admin_inventory.json. Conditions read the subject's own record (hidden truth included: the evaluator's view, never an observation); a room is judged over the things in it. issues (any condition present and holding makes it true, all present and failing make it false, none present leaves it unknown): a paper jam is a printer whose status is a paper or feeder jam, or a sheet jammed in a document feeder; out of paper is a printer whose status says so, or a paper tray with no sheets loaded; low ink is a printer reporting low or empty ink; out of ink a printer whose ink is empty; misdelivered is mail or a parcel for a neighbour, a wrong address or an unknown name (anyone of the household, or the household, makes it false); a former occupant's mail is addressed to someone who moved away; postage due is the carrier's note on a returned piece; crushed is a box the kernel's crush law dented (damage.crushed) or flagged crushed; sagging is a shelf or support the kernel's overload law shows sagging; illegible is a label smudged by water or a thermal receipt faded by heat. states (the first condition whose field the record has decides): shredded is a document cut into strips; a mailbox is flagged while its flag is up and unflagged while it is down. Words without a mapping here (filed, delivered, collected, misfiled, overdue, duplicate, incompatible storage) need more than the subject's own record and are not scored (unknown, never false). The kernel's truth.json owns sealed / unsealed, open / closed, empty, jammed (a shredder's jammed flag), torn and the rest.
